description: This file contains command handler functions for managing runtime options in an ACP (Auto-Configuration Protocol) system, including status, mode, cwd, permissions, timeout, model, and reset actions.

methods.name: resolveTargetSessionKeyOrStop
methods.description: Resolves a target session key or stops execution if resolution fails.

methods.name: resolveOptionalSingleTargetOrStop
methods.description: Parses optional target token and resolves session key or stops if invalid.

methods.name: resolveSingleTargetValueOrStop
methods.description: Resolves a single target value or stops if parsing fails.

methods.name: withSingleTargetValue
methods.description: Executes a callback with a resolved target session key and value.

methods.name: handleAcpStatusAction
methods.description: Handles the 'status' command to retrieve and display session status.

methods.name: handleAcpSetModeAction
methods.description: Handles setting the runtime mode of a session.

methods.name: handleAcpSetAction
methods.description: Handles setting various runtime options or configuration parameters.

methods.name: handleAcpCwdAction
methods.description: Handles updating the current working directory for a session.

methods.name: handleAcpPermissionsAction
methods.description: Handles updating the permissions profile for a session.

methods.name: handleAcpTimeoutAction
methods.description: Handles updating the timeout setting for a session.

methods.name: handleAcpModelAction
methods.description: Handles updating the model parameter for a session.

methods.name: handleAcpResetOptionsAction
methods.description: Handles resetting runtime options for a session.
